vulnerability.name: USN-8150-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that SPIP did not properly sanitize certain inputs. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to perform cross site scripting. (CVE-2022-28959)  It was discovered that SPIP did not properly sanitize certain inputs. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to perform PHP injection attacks. (CVE-2022-28960)  It was discovered that SPIP did not properly sanitize certain inputs. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to perform SQL injection attacks. (CVE-2022-28961)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in SPIP. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
